Now, also fix the ref implementation the same way. Let me rewrite ref.py's term_type with the same ordering.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('ref.py').read()
# Move aggregate branch to the front of term_type
agg_block = '''    if "aggregate" in term:
        assert keys == {"aggregate","field","from","to"}
        op = term["aggregate"]; name = term["field"]; lo = term["from"]; hi = term["to"]
        idx = [i for i,f in enumerate(fields) if f["name"]==name][0]
        assert fields[idx]["type"] in ("TIME","SIZE","COUNT")
        assert is_int(lo) and is_int(hi) and 0<=lo<=hi<K
        if op=="sum":
            return fields[idx]["type"], (lambda ctx,b,idx=idx,lo=lo,hi=hi: sum(ctx[i][idx] for i in range(lo,hi+1)))
        if op=="mean":
            return fields[idx]["type"], (lambda ctx,b,idx=idx,lo=lo,hi=hi: Fraction(sum(ctx[i][idx] for i in range(lo,hi+1)), hi-lo+1))
        if op=="min":
            return fields[idx]["type"], (lambda ctx,b,idx=idx,lo=lo,hi=hi: min(ctx[i][idx] for i in range(lo,hi+1)))
        assert op=="max"
        return fields[idx]["type"], (lambda ctx,b,idx=idx,lo=lo,hi=hi: max(ctx[i][idx] for i in range(lo,hi+1)))
'''
assert agg_block in src
src = src.replace(agg_block, "")
marker = '''    if "field" in term:
        assert keys == {"field", "at"}'''
assert marker in src
src = src.replace(marker, agg_block + marker, 1)
open('ref.py','w').write(src)
EOF
cd /app/submission && fails=0; for s in $(seq 1 60); do python3 /app/tmp/gen.py $s > /app/tmp/r.json; a=$(./run.sh < /app/tmp/r.json); b=$(python3 /app/tmp/ref.py < /app/tmp/r.json); if [ "$a" != "$b" ]; then fails=$((fails+1)); echo "seed $s DIFF"; echo "mine: $a"; echo "ref : $b"; fi; done; echo "fails=$fails"
